title: Picard Iteration for Parameter Estimation in Nonlinear Dynamic Models of Aircraft and Spacecraft
summary: The attitude dynamics of aircraft and spacecraft exhibit significantly nonlinear behaviour. In spacecraft, torque is generated through reaction wheels and control moment gyros. In aircraft, torque is generated using lift on control surfaces. In both cases, complex geometries, unique configurations, and internal/environmental changes imply that models must be identified, verified, and updated using in-flight experimental data.
